headword: {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}

definitions.explanation: The chemical compound CO, an odorless and colorless toxic gas produced by incomplete combustion. A common cause of poisoning from poorly ventilated heaters, charcoal grills, and engine exhaust.

examples.japanese: {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有毒|ゆうどく}→有毒：23801_yuudoku⟧だ。
⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{中毒|ちゅうどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Without ventilation, there's a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}しない→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧よう⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When using a kerosene heater, ventilate regularly to prevent carbon monoxide from building up.

notes:
Composed of {一酸化|いっさんか} (mono-oxide) + ⟦{炭素|たんそ}→炭素：06583_tanso⟧ (carbon). Distinct from ⟦{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}→二酸化炭素：04630_nisankatanso⟧ (CO₂, carbon dioxide), which is also a combustion product but far less acutely toxic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{中毒|ちゅうどく}: carbon monoxide poisoning
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: carbon monoxide is generated
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{警報器|けいほうき}: CO detector

USAGE:
- Odorless and colorless — undetectable without an instrument
- Produced by incomplete combustion (poor ventilation, low oxygen)
- Binds to hemoglobin much more strongly than oxygen, so even low concentrations can be fatal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}→二酸化炭素：04630_nisankatanso⟧: carbon dioxide (CO₂) — exhaled by breathing, much less acutely toxic
- ⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧: oxygen (O₂)
